title: Going deeper: Check before helping
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Offer real choices, preparation and participation without handing over the adult responsibility.
pressureLine: Here, I'll do it for you.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: ask what kind of help would be useful
principle: Respect consent and capability when offering ordinary support.
nextSentence: Help remains available. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can ask what kind of help would be useful.
keyLearning: Respect consent and capability when offering ordinary support.
curriculum: Australian Curriculum v9.0 - Personal and Social capability: Goal setting and social management
